description: Write-up for one piece of design work. Turns a designer's notes, brief or screenshots into a short title, hook, context, process and outcome for a portfolio, LinkedIn or a Shot, then offers a quick check before posting. Use when a designer asks for a project write-up, a portfolio case study, a description or caption for their work.
